CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
